correction: A suite-switch run must activate only its own links: the systemd-sysext refresh merges every pending link of the host, so before it refreshes it checks the host's other pending activations (pendingActivationLinks/activationLinks, deactivations excluded) and, when one exists, keeps its links, skips the refresh and reports RefreshSkipped instead of activating an update that ADR-0016 holds for the next boot. Guard: TestUpdateFeatures_SuiteSwitchKeepsOtherActivationsForNextBoot.
